steps.text:
I built the lecture countdown and recorded it to `/mnt/session/outputs/record.json` (with `record.zip` beside it). It passed `noacg validate` with no errors or warnings, and the coverage run raised no findings. I looked at all 42 coverage frames, which include the take, pause, resume, a long label, an update and the take-off. I would put every one of them on air, so I made no changes after the coverage run.

**The look:** a dark navy band runs the full width of the screen, across the middle, with a gold rule along its top edge.
- **Label:** the operator's text sits on one line at the top, 62px high.
- **Clock:** the remaining time is 250px high, about four times the label's size, so it's the biggest thing on screen and should be readable from the back of the hall. The digits are all the same width, so the clock doesn't shift sideways as it counts.
- **Progress bar:** a gold bar under the clock gets shorter as time runs out.
- **Paused:** the clock dims and the word "PAUSED" appears under it in gold. Space for that word is always kept, so the band doesn't move when it appears.
- **Time's up:** the clock turns gold, blinks twice and stays on 0:00 until the operator takes it off.
